headline: EPS declines sequentially but grows year-over-year
summary_short: Daiwa House Industry reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥134.33, down 33.6% q/q but up 9.0% y/y.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥134.33 fell 33.6% sequentially from ¥202.24 but rose 9.0% year-over-year from ¥123.25. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
